slides.title: It's not the spin.
slides.body: Most misses start with the jump. Your jump changes shape and the rope catches your feet.

slides.title: Same jump, every rep.
slides.body: Small, quick and tall. Legs nearly straight, on the balls of your feet. No tuck, no pike.

slides.title: Elbows in. Wrists turn it.
slides.body: Hands just in front of your hips. Big arm circles make the rope slower, not faster.

slides.title: Singles at double height.
slides.body: Ten tall single unders, then one double. When the jump is right, the rope speeds up on its own.

slides.title: Check the length.
slides.body: Stand on the middle. Handles to about your armpits. Too long and every rep is a lottery.
